title: Unit Testing with JUnit 5
description: Write your first unit tests using JUnit 5 annotations and assertions.

slides.title: JUnit 5 Basics 📋
slides.content:
# Annotations You'll Use

| Annotation | Purpose |
|------------|---------|
| `@Test` | Marks a test method. |
| `@BeforeEach` | Runs before each test. |
| `@AfterEach` | Runs after each test. |
| `@DisplayName` | Gives a descriptive name. |
| `@Disabled` | Skips a test. |

Assertions are in `org.junit.jupiter.api.Assertions`.

quizData.question: Which annotation marks a method as a test in JUnit 5?
quizData.explanation: @Test is the standard JUnit 5 annotation for test methods.
